benchmarks.name: DOMAINS_ANNOTATED
benchmarks.description: InterPro domain analysis of an annotated protein must return at least one domain.
benchmarks.ground_truth: Curated UniProt proteins resolve to 1+ InterPro member signatures (Pfam/SMART/CDD/PANTHER/PROSITE).
benchmarks.citation: Paysan-Lafosse T. et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2023 (InterPro).

benchmarks.name: DOMAINS_GEOMETRY_VALID
benchmarks.description: Every reported domain must have a valid geometry (start <= end within sequence bounds).
benchmarks.ground_truth: A recorded domain analysis must carry a positive sequence length so geometries are interpretable.
benchmarks.citation: Paysan-Lafosse T. et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2023 (InterPro).
